title: Ricky, the Rock that Couldn't Roll
author: Mr. Jay
intro: Ricky is a little rock who loves hanging out with his friends, but he is flat on one side and cannot roll.
checkedAgainst: Storyline Online page and teacher guide

questions.q: What is the main character's name?
questions.clue: His name starts with 'R' like rock.

questions.q: What kind of object is Ricky?
questions.clue: He is hard and sits on the ground.

questions.q: Why can't Ricky roll like his friends?

options.text: He is flat on one side

questions.clue: Look at his shape compared to round rocks.
questions.yes: Ricky cannot roll because he is flat on one side.

questions.q: Where do the rocks love to play and gather?
questions.clue: They go up high to roll down.
questions.yes: The rocks love to play on their favourite hill.

questions.q: How did Ricky feel when he missed out on rolling?
questions.clue: He felt left out because he was different.
questions.yes: Ricky felt sad when he could not roll.

questions.q: Who tries to help Ricky join the fun?

options.text: His rock friends and a ladybug

questions.clue: The other stones and a tiny insect step in.
questions.yes: His rock friends and a ladybug try to help.

questions.q: What do the other round rocks try to do for Ricky?

options.text: Help him roll down the hill

questions.clue: They want him to experience the motion.
questions.yes: The rocks try to help him roll down the hill.

questions.q: When the rocks try pushing him, what happens?

options.text: He just slides or tips over

questions.clue: His flat side stops him from spinning properly.
questions.yes: He just slides or tips over.

questions.q: Why do the rocks refuse to leave Ricky behind?

options.text: Because he is their good friend

questions.clue: Good friends stick together through trouble.
questions.yes: They stay because he is their good friend.

questions.q: What creative idea do the friends come up with?
questions.clue: They find a clever way to get him moving.
questions.yes: They come up with a way to move him along.

questions.q: How does Ricky finally get to travel down the hill?
questions.clue: They use a little board for support.
questions.yes: Ricky travels down using a wheeled board.

questions.q: Where do they all end up together?

options.text: At the bottom of the hill

questions.clue: They travel all the way down the slope.
questions.yes: They all end up at the bottom of the hill.

questions.q: What lesson do the rocks learn about differences?

options.text: Everyone belongs even if they are different
Everyone must look exactly the same

questions.clue: Being unique makes the group special.
questions.yes: They learn everyone belongs even if they are different.

questions.q: Why is it important that the rocks helped Ricky?

options.text: It included him in the fun

questions.clue: Helping him meant no one was left out.
questions.yes: Helping him included him in the fun.

questions.q: How did Ricky feel at the end of the day?
questions.clue: He shared the joy with his companions.
questions.yes: Ricky felt happy at the end of the day.
